title: 电商经营
description: 使用完全合成的订单、商品、退款和推广数据，分析销售、毛利、渠道与退款；不代表真实企业。

tables.name: products
tables.description: 商品参考价与参考成本；实际交易使用订单明细的历史成交值

tables.name: orders
tables.description: 订单表，金额含各行成交额；completed 才计入已完成销售

tables.name: order_items
tables.description: 交易发生时的数量、成交单价和单位成本

tables.name: refunds
tables.description: 退款记录，completed 表示退款成功，processing 不计已退金额

tables.name: marketing_spend
tables.description: 按日及渠道记录推广支出；自然流量支出为零

relations.description: 分别将已完成订单销售与推广费用聚合到日期×渠道后，再同时按日期与渠道关联；不可只按渠道连接原始事实行。
relations.preaggregation: 两侧先分别按全部关联键聚合，包含日期与对象维度，禁止重复累计事实金额。

metrics.name: 销售额
metrics.description: 按 order_date 统计 status='completed' 的订单金额，未扣退款与推广费用；汇总订单层时不可因明细关联重复累计。

metrics.name: 毛利
metrics.description: 仅统计 completed 订单；使用交易发生时的明细成本，不扣退款和推广费用，不能称为净利润。

metrics.name: 毛利率
metrics.description: completed 订单明细；汇总毛利除以汇总销售，不能直接平均各单毛利率；返回0到1比例。
metrics.denominator: 已完成订单明细销售额之和

metrics.name: 退款金额
metrics.description: 按 refund_date 统计退款 status='completed' 的金额；与订单 status 区分。

metrics.name: 客单价
metrics.description: completed 订单销售额除以订单数，先保持每订单一行，金额未扣退款。
metrics.denominator: 同口径已完成订单或交易去重数

metrics.name: 推广产出比
metrics.description: 将 completed 订单销售额及推广费用分别按同一日期×渠道聚合后关联；零支出返回 NULL，不写成零回报或无穷大。

examples.question: 比较2025年各月销售额和毛利，重点观察第四季度。
examples.title: 2025年月度销售与毛利
examples.sql: SELECT strftime(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price),2) AS sales, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*(i.unit_price-i.unit_cost)),2) AS gross_profit FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

examples.question: 2025年各渠道成功退款金额分别是多少？
examples.title: 渠道成功退款金额
examples.sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount),2) AS refund_amount FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id=o.order_id WHERE r.status='completed' AND r.refund_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY refund_amount DESC

examples.question: 比较2025年各渠道销售额、推广支出和ROAS，零支出保留为空。
examples.title: 渠道推广产出比（ROAS）
examples.sql: WITH sales AS(SELECT order_date AS date,channel,SUM(order_total) AS sales FROM orders WHERE status='completed' AND order_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date<DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY order_date,channel),ads AS(SELECT spend_date AS date,channel,SUM(spend) AS spend FROM marketing_spend WHERE spend_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' AND spend_date<DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY spend_date,channel) SELECT a.channel,COALESCE(SUM(s.sales),0) AS sales,SUM(a.spend) AS spend,ROUND(SUM(s.sales)/NULLIF(SUM(a.spend),0),2) AS roas FROM ads a LEFT JOIN sales s ON a.channel=s.channel AND a.date=s.date GROUP BY a.channel ORDER BY a.channel

business_knowledge.title: 退款申请与成功退款
business_knowledge.content: 退款表的 processing 是处理中，仅 completed 才是已退款；按退款日期衡量当期退款。跨表使用 status 字段必须带表别名。

business_knowledge.title: 毛利不是净利润
business_knowledge.content: 本场景毛利使用交易时单价减交易时成本，不扣推广、退款、物流和人员费用。不要用毛利结果回答净利润；缺少费用数据时说明限制。

business_knowledge.title: 多明细关联的重复统计风险
business_knowledge.content: 订单与商品明细、退款明细均为一对多。在合并销售、退款、推广数据前，各自汇总到公共粒度，再用完整公共维度关联。

business_knowledge.title: 合成促销阶段的解释边界
business_knowledge.content: 合成数据在2025年第四季度增加订单并降低部分成交价格，同时提高交易成本。这是模拟机制而非真实运营事件；结论仍需用查询结果证实变化，不能推断真实企业因果。

preferences.title: 默认按渠道展开
preferences.description: 问题没有指定分组时，优先按渠道汇总；本次明确维度优先。

preferences.title: 优先展示毛利
preferences.description: 经营概览优先查看毛利；若需补充该指标，应在查询计划中明确纳入。

preferences.title: 金额使用万元
preferences.description: 仅改变展示单位，SQL原值仍为元，图表必须明确单位。

repair_experiences.title: 渠道汇总遗漏分组
repair_experiences.content: 按渠道汇总金额时，非聚合维度必须进入 GROUP BY。不要用任意值函数隐藏维度错误；以用户要求的渠道粒度聚合。
fixture_sql: CREATE TABLE orders(order_id INTEGER, channel VARCHAR, order_total DOUBLE, status VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO orders VALUES(1,'自然流量',100,'completed'),(2,'自然流量',200,'completed'),(3,'付费推广',80,'completed')
repair_experiences.fixed_sql: SELECT channel,SUM(order_total) FROM orders GROUP BY channel ORDER BY channel

repair_experiences.title: 关联后状态列歧义
repair_experiences.content: 订单和退款都有 status 字段，必须限定表别名。退款成功使用退款状态，不能把订单状态作为退款是否完成的判断。
fixture_sql: CREATE TABLE refunds(order_id INTEGER,status VARCHAR,refund_amount DOUBLE)
repair_experiences.broken_sql: SELECT SUM(refund_amount) FROM orders o JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id=r.order_id WHERE status='completed'
repair_experiences.fixed_sql: SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) FROM orders o JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id=r.order_id WHERE r.status='completed'

repair_experiences.title: 订单明细与退款关联造成金额翻倍
repair_experiences.content: 订单下有多条退款时，将订单明细直接关联退款会放大销售额。分别按订单聚合销售和成功退款，再以订单键关联；检查合并前后销售总额不变。
fixture_sql: CREATE TABLE order_items(order_id INTEGER,quantity INTEGER,unit_price DOUBLE)
CREATE TABLE refunds(order_id INTEGER,refund_amount DOUBLE,status VARCHAR)
repair_experiences.broken_sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS sales,SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refunded FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id=r.order_id
repair_experiences.fixed_sql: WITH s AS(SELECT order_id,SUM(quantity*unit_price) sales FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id),r AS(SELECT order_id,SUM(refund_amount) refunded FROM refunds WHERE status='completed' GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUM(s.sales) AS sales,SUM(r.refunded) AS refunded FROM orders o JOIN s ON o.order_id=s.order_id JOIN r ON o.order_id=r.order_id

repair_experiences.title: 把处理中退款计入成功退款
repair_experiences.content: 退款金额统计需按正式指标卡筛选成功状态。processing 不代表资金已经退回；SQL可执行也要复核状态与时间口径。
fixture_sql: CREATE TABLE refunds(refund_id INTEGER,refund_amount DOUBLE,status VARCHAR)
repair_experiences.fixed_sql: SELECT SUM(refund_amount) FROM refunds WHERE status='completed'

evaluation.question: 有多少个客户？
evaluation.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers

evaluation.question: 2025年12月有多少个订单（包含取消）？
evaluation.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_date>=DATE '2025-12-01' AND order_date<DATE '2026-01-01'

evaluation.question: 分别统计2024年和2025年的订单数（包含取消）。
evaluation.sql: SELECT year(order_date) AS year,COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

evaluation.question: 各渠道总订单数是多少（包含取消）？
evaluation.sql: SELECT channel,COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

evaluation.question: 2025年各渠道完成订单的销售额是多少？
evaluation.sql: SELECT channel,ROUND(SUM(order_total),2) AS sales FROM orders WHERE status='completed' AND order_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

evaluation.question: 2025年各商品类别的毛利是多少？
evaluation.sql: SELECT p.category,ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*(i.unit_price-i.unit_cost)),2) AS gross_profit FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.order_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

evaluation.question: 成功退款金额是多少？
evaluation.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(refund_amount),2) AS refunded FROM refunds WHERE status='completed'

evaluation.question: 各渠道2025年推广支出是多少？
evaluation.sql: SELECT channel,ROUND(SUM(spend),2) AS spend FROM marketing_spend WHERE spend_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

evaluation.question: 2025年已完成订单的客单价是多少？
evaluation.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(order_total)/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id),2) AS aov FROM orders WHERE status='completed' AND order_date>=DATE '2025-01-01'

evaluation.question: 2025年有多少笔成功退款？
evaluation.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refunds FROM refunds WHERE status='completed' AND refund_date>=DATE '2025-01-01'

clarifications.question: 看看利润变化。
clarifications.answer: 按2025年月度毛利分析，不包含退款和营销费用。

clarifications.question: 退款率是多少？
clarifications.answer: 按2025年订单队列，成功退款的订单数除以完成订单数；同一订单多次退款只算一次。
